crossRefs.note: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was…
crossRefs.keyword: secretly. Heb. by stealth. a little

translations.web: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.
translations.bsb: Now a word came to me secretly; my ears caught a whisper of it.
translations.kjv: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little
translations.asv: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, And mine ear received a whisper thereof.
